title: KardenwortErrorCatalog
description: Authoritative, language-agnostic catalog of all permitted structured diagnostic error code identifiers emitted by the Kardenwort-Desk Python backend via print_structured_error. This catalog serves as the canonical enumeration reference for runtime validation, automated testing, and cross-language compilation into Go constants and Rust pattern-matching error enums.

version.description: Semantic version of the error catalog schema.

error_codes.description: Closed set of all permitted diagnostic error code identifiers.

code.description: Canonical error code identifier string. Must match the Python ErrorCode enum member name exactly.

category.description: Broad classification of the error class.

description.description: Human-readable description of when this error code is emitted.

resolution.description: Recommended resolution or diagnostic guidance for clients.

error_codes.description: An unexpected, unhandled Python exception escaped the top-level exception handler. Emitted by the global excepthook.
error_codes.resolution: Inspect the 'details' field for the full Python traceback. Report to the development team if reproducible.

error_codes.description: The process received a KeyboardInterrupt signal (SIGINT). The process is terminating cleanly.
error_codes.resolution: No action required if intentional. If unexpected, verify that no external process sent SIGINT unexpectedly.

error_codes.description: An external subprocess (e.g. kardenwort.py) exceeded its configured time limit and was forcibly terminated.
error_codes.resolution: Increase the timeout configuration value in config.ini or investigate the subprocess for performance regressions.

error_codes.description: A Kardenwort-Desk internal operation failed. Covers TSV loading failures, render errors, column-not-found conditions, and other internal runtime faults.
error_codes.resolution: Inspect the 'message' field for specific failure context. Verify input files and configuration are intact.

error_codes.description: The external kardenwort.py subprocess exited with a non-zero return code indicating processing failure.
error_codes.resolution: Inspect the 'details.stderr' field for kardenwort.py error output. Verify the input text and language configuration.

error_codes.description: A Python unraisable exception occurred (e.g. in a __del__ destructor or background finalizer). Emitted via sys.unraisablehook.
error_codes.resolution: Inspect the 'details' traceback. These are typically non-fatal but may indicate resource cleanup issues.

error_codes.description: A required external dependency (library, binary, or resource file) could not be located or loaded.
error_codes.resolution: Verify that all required dependencies are installed and accessible in the configured paths.

error_codes.description: The application reached an internally inconsistent state that prevents continuing the requested operation.
error_codes.resolution: Check configuration consistency and restart the process. If persistent, report with reproduction steps.

error_codes.description: A configuration file is missing, malformed, or contains invalid values that prevent the operation from proceeding.
error_codes.resolution: Validate config.ini and related configuration files against documented schemas. Correct identified issues and retry.
